title: Breaches in Consecutive Months: Credit Uplift under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
A breach in consecutive months raises the service level credit for the latest census month further under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement. Where the earlier service level credit with the latest billing month is for the month immediately before the claimed month, the credit percentage is multiplied by 1.15; where it is for a month 3 or fewer months before the claimed month but not the month immediately before, by 1.05; otherwise, including when no earlier service level credit exists, it is not multiplied.

The earlier credit looked at is the service level credit on the agreement with the latest billing month, compared month for month with the claimed month.

| Billing month of that earlier credit | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| the month immediately before the claimed month | 1.15 |
| 2 months before | 1.05 |
| 3 months before | 1.05 |
| 4 or more months before | none |
| no earlier service level credit | none |

For a claimed month of September (hypothetical), an earlier credit for August gives 1.15, one for June gives 1.05, and one for May gives none.
